newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia produces 1.43 mln bpd crude in December.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia produces 1.43 mln bpd crude in December.

text.p: Indonesia produced 1.43 million barrels per day (bpd) of crude oil and 180,000 bpd of condensate in December, an oil industry source said on Thursday.

"Indonesia produced 1.43 million bpd of crude oil in December, but the production included 60,000 bpd for own use in the Duri steam flood project," the source said. Condensate output was 180,000 bpd, he said.
The Duri field, operated by PT Caltex Pacific Indonesia, produces between 290,000 to 300,000 bpd, the source said.
Caltex is jointly owned by Chevron Corp and Texaco Inc.
Indonesia has an OPEC quota of 1.330 million bpd.
